summary: BridgeBio Oncology Therapeutics filed an 8-K furnishing a September 8, 2026 press release and updated corporate presentation. The release reports new clinical data for KRAS G12C inhibitor BBO-8520, including 75% ORR at 500 mg in 2L+ KRAS G12C inhibitor-experienced NSCLC and 63% ORR monotherapy in inhibitor-naive patients, plus strategic prioritization of BBO-8520 combination and BBO-11818/BBO-10203 combinations. Cash of $344.1 million as of June 30, 2026 supports runway into 2028. This is a routine scientific/strategy update, not a special situation; no deal terms, board recommendation, or advisor.
